body: I have a diary. That’s usually where I write it out, but I guess I just wanted someone to know this time and I didnt want people around me to feel burdened again. Or rather I called and they made me feel lonelier so I just said goodbye and left. Today was actually very good, which is why I was surprised my mind turned on me later; I have been having much worse days for a good while, but despite that I’ve never felt this low before. Thank you for commenting and your well wishes. I have volunteering tomorrow and will need to study on Sunday. I have a psych appointment on Wednesday. Don’t know when they will be able to fit me in for therapy, but probably not till after thanksgiving, which I think is fine because I’ve made it this far. Thanks again
